summary.intent: Drive the monokl code-search project's open PRs to merge: verify a subagent's fixes for 7 review findings on the Rust analyzer PR (#77), get the language-filter PR opened, and start follow-on work (held-out eval set, performance ADR).
summary.outcome: Verified the subagent's fixes (5 keywords confirmed, all 7 findings resolved), found #74/#75/#76/#78 merged, opened and marked ready #79 by relinking its trail against main, and launched two agents for a held-out question set and ADR 0004. #77 CI was still running and #77/#79 still await approval.

repo: Entire only opens a GitHub PR for a trail whose base branch exists; the language-filter branch was stacked on #74, so after #74 merged it had no valid base and no PR appeared until the trail was relinked against main.
Merge order matters because PRs are stacked: #76, then #77, then #74/#75/#78, with the language-filter PR after #74.
`cargo publish --dry-run --no-verify` does not validate the crates.io five-keyword limit, so keyword count must be checked by reading Cargo.toml.
The harness baseline on the TypeScript eval is 58/59, 17/18, 15/16 and `python3 -I scripts/rg-compare.py` must exit 0 after `cargo build --release`; `just ci` is the main CI gate.

Bounded-work fixes (fixed-stack parse with nesting pre-scan, size-before-read, hit-text cap, --timeout, CI scaling tests) edit the same parse and text-search code as #77 and #79, so they are sequenced after those merge.
workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output, not user instruction; verify claims independently (keyword count, CI state, PR state) before relaying them.
Check machine load before running benchmarks so measurements are taken on an idle machine.
Run parallel agents only on disjoint files to avoid conflicts (eval question set vs docs-only ADR).
Held-out eval sets should be scored on their own lines with gates at 0 and a rule that misses are never fixed by editing the question, to guard against overfitting.

friction: Entire did not open a GitHub PR for the language-filter branch even after an initial relink, until the stale stacked base was recognized.
#77 CI was still running, so it could not be called green.
Earlier the PR-creation step required the bot app, a step the agent could not perform itself.
Benchmark identifier sampling included files monokl never searches, skewing results.
open_items: Wait for #77 CI to finish and for user approval on Entire Gates for #77 and #79.
Start the bounded-work fixes (fixed-stack parse, size-before-read, hit-text cap, --timeout, CI scaling tests) after #77 and #79 merge.
Review results of the held-out question set (fastify, trpc, date-fns) and the ADR 0004 draft when the agents finish.
Stages that still violate ADR 0004's bounded-work rules are listed as follow-up, not done.
Test-gated struct fields and enum variants inside a regular block are not handled by the Rust analyzer; judged outside the finding.
Measure #74 and #75 together on main with the new benchmark; the benchmark was run and read but results are not reported in the transcript.
